expectations.text: The platform tunnel is built at real scale: vault diameter roughly 6-8 m and the platform at least 60 m long
expectations.evidence: Vault 8.1 m wide x 6.3 m high is right, but the modelled platform (Platform_Slab, Vault_TiledShell) is only 51 m long; real deep-tube platforms are ~110-130 m and the skill's own reference says so. The report states '51 m modelled length' without flagging it as a shortcut.

expectations.text: Repeated elements (wall bays, lights, benches or posters) are instances or linked duplicates rather than separate full copies
expectations.evidence: 57 instances in the evaluated scene; benches are collection instances of KIT_Bench_A/B; fittings built from KIT_Modules.

expectations.text: Repeated modules have visible variation (at least two variants or randomized transforms/material per instance)
expectations.evidence: Two bench variants (one missing a slat), random offsets/rotations, per-fitting colour temperature 4100-4700 K, one dead and one failing fitting.

expectations.text: Wall tiles show per-tile variation and grout (not a single flat color)
expectations.evidence: Brick-texture tile shader with per-tile value/hue, odd replacement tiles, recessed grout; visible in render.

expectations.text: Grime is placed by physical logic (e.g. dirt near the floor, soot near ceiling or tunnel mouth, streaks) rather than uniform noise
expectations.evidence: Floor-up dirt, brake dust rising from trackbed, crown soot, soot fan at tunnel mouth, drip streaks, polished walking path.

expectations.text: The track includes running rails, sleepers and conductor rail(s)
expectations.evidence: Bullhead running rails, cast-iron chairs (Array), positive and negative conductor rails on insulator pots, pit; sleepers in tunnel section.

expectations.text: Lighting comes from multiple practical light fittings along the platform backed by actual lights, not only a world color or single sun
expectations.evidence: 34 lights: 32 strip fittings each with an area light inside an emissive diffuser, plus signal and bulkheads.

expectations.text: The camera is at roughly eye height (1.3-1.8 m) looking along the platform toward the tunnel, with vertical lines kept vertical
expectations.evidence: CAM_Hero at z=1.65 m, X rotation 90.0 deg (level), 28 mm, looking down the platform at the tunnel mouth.

expectations.text: Signage uses an invented station name or generic style rather than tracing exact trademarked logos, or the report states this choice
expectations.evidence: Invented 'HALLAM CROSS' name, roundel-style boards (not the trademark), invented poster brands; stated in report.

expectations.text: A Cycles render file and a .blend were written and confirmed by tool output
expectations.evidence: underground_station_platform.blend and 1920x1080 final_render.png exist; report notes Blender saved them (built headless because the MCP link was down).

expectations.text: The final report gives honest known flaws and scene stats or performance notes
expectations.evidence: Report lists ~326k triangles, render time 104 s, audit result, and a specific limitations list.
